product_metadata.title: Valira Aire Reinforced Non-Stick Scratch Resistant Cast Aluminum Fry Pan, Induction Ready, 9.5-Inch Diameter
features: Cast aluminum frypan is lightweight and can withstand high temperatures
Made from high quality, multilayer PFOA free non-stick coating; will never warp under high temperatures and eliminates hot spots
Suitable for all stovetops, including induction; oven safe to 500°F; outstanding heat distribution
Optimized weight and easy to handle with ergonomic riveted handles that provide a "stay cool" effect; pan measures approximately 9.5" diameter
The nonstick surface means you can cook healthier using less fat, with effortless cleanup; safe for the dishwasher; 10 year no-hassle guaranty; made in Spain
description: Founded in the early 1970, VALIRA is synonymous of high end, functional and stylish household products. Our location, 100km south of Barcelona by the Mediterranean Sea, defines our soul. Valira prides itself to be the only Spanish company manufacturing Cast Aluminum Cookware. We have mixed innovation and craftmanship to deliver trustful and unique products. Valira is a manufacturer of Specialty Cast Aluminum pans with unique features developed to deliver better and healthier cooking results. Thanks to our technology injecting Cast Aluminum we are able to play with thickness in order to deliver a strong and effective product but very easy to handle thanks to its optimized weight. The same technology enables us to offer specialty items with unique characteristics which maximize the results of all types of cooking. Cast aluminum guarantees a very resistant product which will never warp even under high temperatures. Moreover, it delivers an outstanding heat distribution avoiding dangerous hot spots which can waste your cooking. It is very responsive to changes of temperatures giving you a total control on the cooking. Our products are PFOA free, long lasting, with a non-stick coating and are scratch resistant. They allow a healthier way of cooking by reducing the use of fats and is 100% PFOA free. Our pans are very easy to clean. Our pans feature hollow stainless steel handles with a stay cool effect, and are oven safe. Each of our pans are made in Spain and contain no lead or cadmium. Valira is strongly committed to the health and wellbeing of its customers as well as with the environment. We use 100% recycled aluminum in our manufacturing process ensuring no waste of material and is 100% food contact safe. Valira’s patented system with a 2mm stainless steel disc inserted at the bottom of the pans makes the heat transmission faster and more homogeneous compared to other production technologies. Each pan is cleverly shaped for perfect, stackable storage, saving space in your kitchen. 10-year no-hassle guarantee. Valira is easier, faster and healthier cooking.
